rows.ARS:
White, near white or white blend Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: MEIbleri
rows.Origin:
Bred by Marie-Louise (Louisette) Meilland (Paolino) (1920-1987) (France, before 1984).
Introduced in France by Meilland et Cie in 1984 as 'Alliance'.
rows.Bloom: White. None / no fragrance. Large, semi-double (9-16 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Upright. Medium, matte, dark green foliage.

Height: 28" to 35" (70 to 90cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b and warmer. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) .
rows.Notes: Flowers are large, light red and deep pink. And fragrant.
